decisions.reason: The Blockaid false-positive report and developer-verification submission do not change the Transak fiat-mint flow, provider, or wallet-provisioning rules.
Submitting the project to Blockaid is unrelated to the customer-support form's placement, fields, purposes, and submission control.
The security-warning remediation does not alter authentication requirements or information exposed through public APIs.
The Blockaid verification request does not affect the Discord server, invitation, channels, moderation, or community configuration.
Blockaid developer verification is distinct from Chainlink VRF winner selection and Basescan verification; no randomness or draw rule changes.
The source requests an external Blockaid submission and does not require any landing-page copy, layout, or visibility change.
The malicious-site warning remediation does not modify the connected-wallet USDC mint behavior.
The Blockaid report and verification submission do not change ETH pricing, swap, shortfall, or refund semantics.
The security-warning remediation does not change IPFS storage, Pinata usage, or the ebook takedown option.
Although the FAQ discusses scams and source verification, the source message requests only a Blockaid false-positive and developer-verification submission and does not require FAQ copy changes.
Blockaid project verification does not alter royalty amount, enforcement, NFT standard, or marketplace policy.
The developer-verification section referenced by the source is Blockaid project verification, not user email verification or magic-link authentication.
